================================================================================
cppo directives between structure items and match arms
================================================================================

#ifdef STRINGLIT
let has_stringlit = true
#endif
let typeof js = match js with
  | `Floatlit _ -> "floatlit"
#ifdef STRINGLIT
  | `Stringlit _ -> "stringlit"
#endif

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (cppo_directive)
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (boolean)))
  (cppo_directive)
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (parameter
        (value_pattern))
      (match_expression
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (any_pattern))
          (string
            (string_content)))
        (cppo_directive)
        (match_case
          (tag_pattern
            (tag)
            (any_pattern))
          (string
            (string_content)))
        (cppo_directive)))))

================================================================================
camlp4 conditional section as a let body
================================================================================

let to_string =
  #<If:TESTING>
    original_name
  #<Else>
    function
    | FakeSource n -> n
    | Source n -> n
  #<End>
let y = 2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (camlp4_conditional
        (camlp4_directive)
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (camlp4_directive)
        (function_expression
          (match_case
            (constructor_pattern
              (constructor_path
                (constructor_name))
              (value_pattern))
            (value_path
              (value_name)))
          (match_case
            (constructor_pattern
              (constructor_path
                (constructor_name))
              (value_pattern))
            (value_path
              (value_name))))
        (camlp4_end_directive))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))

================================================================================
cppo directive between a `|` marker and its match arm
================================================================================

let f v = match v with
  | A -> 1
  | #ifdef Y
    C -> 3
#endif
let g = 1

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (parameter
        (value_pattern))
      (match_expression
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (match_case
          (constructor_path
            (constructor_name))
          (number))
        (cppo_directive)
        (match_case
          (constructor_path
            (constructor_name))
          (number))
        (cppo_directive))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))

================================================================================
camlp4 `#<Else>` arm separator after a function branch
================================================================================

  #<If:A>
    function
    | X -> 1
  #<Else>
    g
  #<End>
let y = 2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (camlp4_conditional
        (camlp4_directive)
        (function_expression
          (match_case
            (constructor_path
              (constructor_name))
            (number)))
        (camlp4_directive)
        (value_path
          (value_name))
        (camlp4_end_directive))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))

================================================================================
nested camlp4 conditional as a conditional arm
================================================================================

let x =
  #<If:A>
    #<If:B>
      1
    #<End>
  #<Else>
    2
  #<End>
let y = 2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (camlp4_conditional
        (camlp4_directive)
        (camlp4_conditional
          (camlp4_directive)
          (number)
          (camlp4_end_directive))
        (camlp4_directive)
        (number)
        (camlp4_end_directive))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))

================================================================================
polymorphic-variant pattern arm after a directive-looking keyword
================================================================================

let f = function
  | `A -> 1
  | #error as e -> pp_error ppf e
let g = 2

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(compilation_unit
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (function_expression
        (match_case
          (tag)
          (number))
        (match_case
          (alias_pattern
            (polymorphic_variant_pattern
              (type_constructor_path
                (type_constructor)))
            (value_pattern))
          (application_expression
            (value_path
              (value_name))
            (value_path
              (value_name))
            (value_path
              (value_name)))))))
  (value_definition
    (let_binding
      (value_name)
      (number))))
